subject: Mutual Action Plan rephase request — procurement holdback
messages:
From: Sarah Lopez <sarah.lopez@helioshealth.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Cc: Mark Ellis <mark.ellis@helioshealth.com>, procurement@helioshealth.com
Date: Mon, 30 Jun 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Draft MAP & evaluation timeline — potential hold

Hi Marissa,

Thanks for the MAP spreadsheet — we reviewed it with procurement this morning. There are two items blocking sign: 1) procurement needs the SOC2 summary and data retention controls documented in writing, and 2) legal wants a 30-day trial clause clarified in the SOW. Because procurement has a scheduled vendor review next week, they can't approve the MAP until that meeting completes.

Realistically, that pushes our target go-live out by at least one full week. I know this impacts your internal timelines — can we formally rephase the MAP (deliverables + acceptance dates) and update the SOW? If you can send the SOC2 summary + a revised MAP by end of day Tuesday, we can try to move the vendor review forward.

Appreciate it —
Sarah

Sarah Lopez
Director, Infrastructure & Integrations
Helios Health

[Helios procurement meeting: Wed 07/02 11:00am PST]

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Lopez <sarah.lopez@helioshealth.com>
Cc: Mark Ellis <mark.ellis@helioshealth.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Jun 2025 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Draft MAP & evaluation timeline — potential hold

Thanks Sarah — understood. We're prioritizing the SOC2 summary and will send the redline to the MAP and SOW by EOD Tuesday (7/1).

Quick next steps from our side:
- I'll attach an annotated MAP with revised acceptance dates (moving the go-live target +7 days and compressing the evaluation window by 3 days to keep momentum).
- Prio: SOC2_summary.pdf (attached) + short note on data retention retention policies (see page 2).
- If procurement still requests a legal change, we can issue a limited 30-day trial addendum via DocuSign while legal reviews the main SOW.

I realize this introduces risk to our internal commitment. If Helios confirms the vendor review earlier, we can accelerate — but for planning, I'm going to treat 7/09 as the new acceptance target unless you tell me otherwise.

I'll follow up with an internal note to ops and my manager to surface the timeline drift.

Best,
Marissa
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com
Attachments: SOC2_summary.pdf

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: jonas_weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>, priyom_das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 1 Jul 2025 08:22:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Draft MAP & evaluation timeline — procurement hold (Helios)

Jonas / Priyom — forwarding Helios thread: procurement flagged SOC2 + a trial clause; they now expect a one-week slip to the MAP.

Why I'm looping you:
- We need a quick green-light on issuing the revised MAP + a short credit/incubation offer if they insist on the 30-day trial addendum.
- Priyom, can your team provide the SOC2 summary + a one-paragraph data retention statement suitable for procurement (I attached the draft SOC2_summary.pdf we plan to send)? Ideally we send the final by EOD Tuesday to try to expedite their Wed vendor meeting.

My proposed mitigation (please approve or suggest alternatives):
1) Send revised MAP with new dates (attached Helios_MAP_v3.xlsx).
2) Offer a single 2-week credit (up to $10k) if procurement insists on a 30-day formal trial addendum — helps offset their risk and keeps ARR intact.
3) If legal insists on SOW redlines that block signature, issue a DocuSign limited addendum for the trial clause so we don't hold the entire contract.

Risk notes: delaying acceptance by a week reduces our forecasted Q3 ramp and triggers engineering priority shifts (KV cache tuning deployment might slip). If we authorize the credit, finance will want sign-off.

Thoughts?

—Marissa

From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, priyom_das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 1 Jul 2025 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Draft MAP & evaluation timeline — procurement hold (Helios)

Marissa — thanks for the quick heads up.

Do the following:
- Priyom: finalize the SOC2_summary.pdf AND add a two-line data-retention statement. Mark it as "Procurement summary" so it’s clear. Get it to Marissa within 4 working hours.
- Marissa: OK to offer a two-week credit up to $10k as a one-time accommodation; note this on the revised MAP under "commercial accommodations" and require a signature on the addendum. Finance will clear but needs the exact credit line item.
- If Helios insists on a 30-day trial clause, use DocuSign to attach a limited addendum to the SOW rather than reworking the master SOW. Operations should preserve the original deployment cadence in the MAP but shift the acceptance date +7 days.

Escalation: If procurement still refuses after the SOC2 summary and addendum, escalate to me and I’ll join the vendor review. Do not commit further credits.

Jonas
VP, Sales — Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Lopez <sarah.lopez@helioshealth.com>, Mark Ellis <mark.ellis@helioshealth.com>
Cc: priyom_das <priyom_das@redwood.com>, jonas_weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 8 Jul 2025 16:05:00 -0700
Subject: MAP update & next steps — Helios procurement review (action required)

Hi Sarah / Mark — thanks for the vendor review today. Appreciate the quick feedback.

Summary of agreed items and next steps (per procurement call):
- Deliverables / Dates: updated MAP attached (Helios_MAP_v3.xlsx). Acceptance date moved from 2025-07-02 to 2025-07-09. Evaluation window compressed by 3 days to keep cutover tight.
- Compliance artifacts: SOC2_summary.pdf (attached) and a two-line data retention statement provided by our security team. See attachment.
- Commercial accommodation: Redwood will issue a one-time 2-week credit, not to exceed $10,000, contingent on an executed addendum (DocuSign link below). This is intended to offset trial risk while legal finalizes the SOW redline.
- DocuSign: https://www.docusign.net/Member/PowerFormSigning.aspx?PowerFormId=abcd-1234 — please sign the limited trial addendum by end of day Friday 7/11 to lock the credit.

If procurement confirms their vendor review outcome earlier, we can revert to the original target; for now we are treating 2025-07-09 as the committed acceptance date. If anything changes from your side, please reply-all.

Thanks again,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com
Attachments: Helios_MAP_v3.xlsx, SOC2_summary.pdf
